name: Price drop promo
description: A sale screen for a price cut: the product picture on a coloured ring, the old price, a big new price and a savings sticker, with a bottom bar for your terms and an optional live countdown to the end of the offer.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A square-ish PNG or SVG. The bundled badge is a placeholder; replace it with your own.

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: Turn off if you have no logo (an empty logo setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: brand
params.label: Store name
params.help: Shown beside the logo. Leave empty if your logo already says it.

params.name: badge
params.label: Badge
params.help: The pill above the headline. Leave empty and the pill stays as a plain coloured tab.

params.name: headline
params.label: Product / headline
params.help: Room for three lines; 40 characters is the most that always fits.

params.name: was_price
params.label: Was-price line
params.help: Type it as it should read, e.g. "Was $249.00" or "Avant 249,00 €". Leave empty to hide.

params.name: price
params.label: New price
params.help: The big number, as it should read: $179, 179 €, £1,299.99.

params.name: save_text
params.label: Savings sticker
params.help: On the yellow sticker over the picture. Keep it short: SAVE $70, -30%, HALF PRICE.

params.name: product_image
params.label: Product picture
params.help: A cut-out PNG or SVG with a transparent background works best. It is fitted, never cropped.

params.name: show_image
params.label: Show the product picture
params.help: Turn off to leave the panel without a picture (an empty picture setting would otherwise show a dashed box).

params.name: show_countdown
params.label: Show the countdown
params.help: Turn off for an offer with no end date: the label and timer both disappear.

params.name: countdown_label
params.label: Label above the countdown
params.help: It stays after the offer ends, so pick words that read well with the end message too.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: The language of the live countdown, e.g. de or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen’s language. Your own text is shown exactly as you type it.

params.name: small_print
params.label: Small print
params.help: Terms along the bottom bar. A sentence or two.
params.default: Offer ends 31 December 2026 or while stocks last. One per customer. In store and online.

params.name: accent
params.label: Accent colour
params.help: The badge, the bottom bar and the ring behind the picture.

params.name: highlight
params.label: Price colour
params.help: The new price and the savings sticker.

params.name: background
params.label: Background colour
params.help: Also the text colour on the sticker.

params.name: background_image
params.label: Background photo
params.help: Optional. A photo behind everything, darkened by the setting below.

params.name: background_dim
params.label: Darken the photo
params.help: 0 = the photo as is, 0.9 = almost black. Only used with a background photo.
